risks.proof: A short video clip of the kettle being plugged in, switched on, and boiling water

risks.risk: Cord or plug could have internal wear/damage not visible in a still photo
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the full cord length and plug pins, free of cuts or exposed wire
Photo of any embossed/printed capacity marking, or a water-fill test to a marked line
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/unverified capacity, treat as standard size

risks.risk: Interior discoloration could indicate limescale buildup or corrosion affecting lifespan
risks.proof: Clearer close-up photo of the interior base and element after cleaning

risks.risk: 'London used' claim could just be a sales label with no real import history, affecting perceived value
risks.proof: Any receipt, import tag, or original packaging photo
risks.if_unproven: priced as ordinary used local-market item, no premium for import claim

proof_requests: Video of the kettle plugged in and boiling water
Close-up photo of cord and plug pins showing no damage
Close-up photo of any brand/model/capacity marking on the kettle
Clearer photo of interior after wiping, showing element and base condition
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a generic stainless steel electric kettle by type, so it can be priced at worst case (untested function, unverified brand/capacity, visible interior wear) even though several seller claims remain unverified.
